anchor.semantic_hook: Equipping oneself is staged as standing on a provisioning platform while the needed resource or tool is physically fitted to the occupant.
anchor.setting: An empty equipment depot contains a central outfitting platform, open storage bays, cable ports, and a fitting bench for interchangeable resources. One colossal articulated fitting arm coils around the platform and holds the required equipment ready for attachment.
anchor.absurd_element: one colossal articulated fitting arm coiling around the outfitting platform

variations.scene_adjust: a home workstation with a laptop, headset, router, network cable, and apartment window

variations.scene_adjust: an intricate half-assembled model and a large hourglass on the fitting bench

variations.scene_adjust: rows of classroom desks, new computers, keyboards, mice, and cable sockets

anchor.absurd_element: the world-map floor folding into an immense right-angle corner

variations.scene_adjust: two neighboring country blocks, a connected gas pipeline, valve wheels, and a Europe-shaped region of the map

variations.scene_adjust: plain ballot boxes, unmarked voting slips, colored counters, and a cluster of regional country blocks
